question: 同一批免疫细胞，为什么不同方法给出的名字不一样？哪些可以相信，哪些应该暂缓判断？

input.source: CAMUS PBMC.zip and official 10x pbmc_granulocyte_sorted_10k cell-arc 1.0.0
input.identity: All 9,631 author RNA barcodes and all 29,095 shared-gene counts match official data exactly

invariants: Run annotation methods from RNA reference and ATAC measurements, not precomputed predictions
Never load query labels or query-cell RNA in annotation or method ranking
Freeze ranking before evaluating with held-out author annotations
CAMUS scores are not accuracy or individual-cell probabilities
Use measured ATAC evidence and distinguish it from gene activity or predicted RNA
Record real disagreements; allow zero improvement over baseline
Preserve all original session turns and execution records
Deliver source data objects, figures, uncertainty list, tex, bib and PDF in Results
limitations: Same-donor cell split is not cross-donor validation
Author labels are evaluation references, not independent experimental ground truth
Reference split differs from paper and can change performance
Rare types with few reference cells require separate reporting

independent.note: Independent scout only; not formal Agent results

formal.note: Post-hoc comparison with author annotations, never supplied to the formal Agent. Not experimental ground truth.

publication.reason: Explain score differences before deciding showcase; current report may finish but is not published as CAMUS success.

issues: Current CAMUS near-tie does not support reliable method-selection benefit
Report uses confirmed/independent confirmation for same-reference heuristic support
query_analysis.h5ad is 4816x1, not the original count matrix described in final answer; obs index and CSV cell column use row numbers
PDF has overfull boxes requiring layout review

posthoc_A_tier.note: Selected subset with reduced coverage; neither independent truth nor CAMUS contribution.

delivery_review.recommendation: Retain as internal audit; validate a standard workflow on the same dataset before selecting a new formal CAMUS demonstration.
